messages:
alex_j: Quick heads-up — scheduling a short rolling maintenance for EU-west KV cache compaction + prefetch optimization.
When: 2026-04-02 01:00–01:30 UTC (rolling by AZ, ~5–7 min per AZ).
Expected impact: transient 502/503s for requests hitting local cache partition during compaction; global fallback to replica region enabled (latency increase ~50–150ms).
Customer-facing impact: no data loss, briefly elevated error rate for a small fraction of traffic.
Action items:
- @eng_oncall: monitor 5xx rate + latency, page if 5xx > 1% for 3m
- @maria_ops: post status page + customer email draft below
- @ops-bot: schedule job in infra-runner 01:00 UTC
Please ack if this conflicts with any scheduled jobs.

maria_ops: Ack. Drafting status page and customer email now. We'll keep list of affected customer regions.

csm_liz: Can we shift to 03:00 UTC? A few EU customers have backups at 01:15.

alex_j: I checked — 03:00 conflicts with AM batch for two customers. We can split: start at 00:40 and finish by 01:10? That reduces overlap.

pm_arya: Prefer earlier window. OK from PM side.

eng_oncall: I'll be on pager. Runbooks: if 5xx spike, toggle `kv_prefetch:off` via `infra-toggle --service kv --region eu-west1`; fallback policy already set to `eu-west1-readonly -> us-west1`.

statusbot: Scheduled maintenance created: infra-runner job 2981 at 3765478800 (01:00 UTC). Reminder set 30m before.

maria_ops: Status page draft (please copy/edit):
```
Title: Scheduled maintenance — EU-west KV compaction
Start: 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC
Expected impact: brief request errors and higher latency for a small portion of traffic. No data loss.
Updates: We'll post when maintenance begins, when any customer-visible impacts occur, and once complete.
```

Customer email (short):
```
Subject: Notice: brief maintenance in EU (Apr 2)
Hi — We will perform maintenance in our EU region on Apr 2 01:00 UTC. You may see brief request errors; services will automatically route to replicas. No action required.
```

eng_oncall: Added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-maint-2026

ops-bot: Preflight checks passed: node health OK, replicas synced.

alex_j: ok proceeding with 00:40 start to avoid heavy backups. Maria, please push status page at T-20m.

maria_ops: will do. posting now.

statusbot: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/kv-eu-2026

eng_oncall: monitoring — all metrics normal so far. will escalate if thresholds hit.

csm_liz: sending customer heads-up to list.

ops-bot: Maintenance started (eu-west1-a). compaction step 1/4.

eng_oncall: small spike to 0.8% 5xx, under threshold.

ops-bot: compaction step 2/4: still rolling.

eng_oncall: 5xx spike up to 1.9% — paging escalation.

eng_oncall: paging @oncall-sre (pager sent)

oncall-sre: picking up. Triage: found overloaded KV shard, initiating throttle and enabling prefetch-off.

oncall-sre: errors dropping back to 0.3%.

ops-bot: compaction resumed, step 3/4.

alex_j: Good catch. Follow-up: add note to status page about brief elevated errors.

maria_ops: updated status page with note and ETA.

ops-bot: compaction completed (step 4/4). finalizing.

eng_oncall: monitoring — 5xx back to baseline, latency normal.

maria_ops: Posting completion notice to status page and sending follow-up email to customers.

statusbot: Status page: resolved. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/kv-eu-2026/resolved

alex_j: thanks everyone — closing thread. :thumbsup:
